brand_identity.tone: Premium, minimal, modern, clean, young, high-tension competitive esports with a 10-15% subtle Halloween-inspired atmospheric vibe (faint eclipse glow, orange mist/particles, abstract geometric grid; NO cartoon horror or cheap clipart).

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight leading-none
headings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tight

visual_enhancers.halloween_vibe: Keep to 10-15% subtle overlay only. Use faint orange atmospheric radial gradients, subtle dark eclipse/moon glow in hero background, fine grain texture overlay, abstract wireframe grid lines, and glowing ambient particles. Do NOT add pumpkins, ghosts, skulls, or horror clipart.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) with dynamic hover transition to border-orange-500/40
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient subtle drop shadow + hover box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.2)

image_urls.description: Cyber arena neon dark ambient setup
Dark tactical chess on illuminated surface
Gamers in cyber arena with neon glow
Abstract geometric pattern with glowing orange and dark metallic shapes

content_guidelines.prize_pool: Exactly ₹XX,XXX or TO BE ANNOUNCED / COMING SOON. Never invent a numeric dollar/rupee amount.
content_guidelines.dates_fees_sponsors: Mark as COMING SOON or TO BE ANNOUNCED. Never create fake sponsors or registration fees.
content_guidelines.links: All external links must use target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'.
content_guidelines.data_testids: All interactive elements, buttons, links, modals, and nav items MUST include role-based data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='register-now-btn', data-testid='game-modal-trigger').

layout_structure.header: Sticky glassmorphism navbar with KRIDANGAN logo, nav links (Hero, Intro, Games, Prizes, Highlights, About, Contact), and REGISTER NOW CTA.
layout_structure.hero: Dynamic headline, JamRang / Vijaybhoomi badge, 10-15% Halloween orange glow / eclipse vibe, primary and secondary CTA buttons.
layout_structure.intro: Brief overview of KRIDANGAN under JamRang at Vijaybhoomi University by NxtGen Esports Club.
layout_structure.games: Grid of 3 featured games (Free Fire, Chess, E-Football) with badges and CHOOSE YOUR BATTLE trigger opening Game Picker Modal.
layout_structure.prize_pool: High-impact card displaying THE STAKES ARE HIGH with exact ₹XX,XXX representation.
layout_structure.highlights: Bento grid displaying event features, competitive spirit, live streams, and arena atmosphere.
layout_structure.about: Official section on JamRang and Vijaybhoomi University with external link.
layout_structure.registration_modal: Game Picker modal displaying game choices with disabled COMING SOON buttons for external Google Forms.
layout_structure.contact_page: Separate /contact page with Instagram and email links.
layout_structure.footer: Clean dark footer with copyright, club credits, and social links.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always set explicit text color on hover and interactive states.
All links opening in new tab must use rel='noopener noreferrer'.
Never use generic transparent headers without backdrop blur.
Include data-testid on every interactive button, input, card CTA, and link.
